text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and understand text, so they can find the main ideas in a document or answer questions about it. NLP is also used for translation, which means it can change text from one language into another quickly and accurately. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where computers study words to discover if a review is positive or negative. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people, understand their questions, and give helpful answers. Thanks to NLP, our daily digital experiences are becoming easier and more natural.
